name: Add Button Component
description: Create a new Button component with variants (primary, secondary, danger) and sizes (small, medium, large)
prompt: Create a Button component in src/components/Button.tsx with TypeScript. The component should support variants: primary, secondary, danger. And sizes: small, medium, large. Use Tailwind CSS for styling. Export the component and a ButtonProps interface.
acceptance: Supports variant prop with values: primary, secondary, danger
Supports size prop with values: small, medium, large
